name: WPA Human-Governed Agentic Institution Model
world_first_claim_policy: No world-first claim unless an independent prior-art review supports it.
public_principle: Machines may coordinate. Agents may prepare and recommend. Only authorised humans may commit consequential institutional actions.
long_term_objective: End-to-end human-governed agentic institute workflows from intake and research through learning, assessment, publication and completion, with explicit human authority for consequential decisions.
continuous_learning_principle: Institutional strength is not the sum of its components; it is the quality of the governed connections between them.
ai_acceleration_boundary: AI may accelerate discovery, comparison, modelling, synthesis and iteration; it does not inherit institutional mandate, legitimacy or final responsibility.

authority_layers.name: Human Authority
authority_layers.role: mandate, approval, pause, override and accountability

authority_layers.name: WPA Doctrine Kernel
authority_layers.role: truth, doctrine, authorial-dna and drift controls

authority_layers.name: Strategic AI Core
authority_layers.role: strategic planning and independent review; provider adapters must be explicitly verified

authority_layers.name: Virtual Sande
authority_layers.role: central orchestration, source-disciplined interface and synthesis

authority_layers.name: WPA AI Council
authority_layers.role: bounded tactical-operational task execution under approved directive

authority_layers.name: External AI Candidate Registry
authority_layers.role: candidate external AI seats; no affiliation or live integration implied

capability_resilience_rule: Every new institutional capability must be evaluated together with the dependency, vulnerability, misuse path and authority risk it creates.

outcome_based_protocolometry.principle: Measure institutional performance by evidence-backed outcomes and correction capacity, not by the number of units, documents, agents or organisational labels.

non_claims: No intelligence, surveillance, investigative or operational function
No provider partnership or endorsement without evidence
No external-customer deployment claim without verifiable delivery evidence
No Human Gate bypass through continuous learning or AI acceleration
